name: Firecrawl MCP Server
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C3, C4, C6, C10; partly meets C5, C7, C8; does not meet C2, C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for firecrawl-mcp@3.40.0 names the repository `git+https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server.git` and carries a provenance attestation (`dist.attestations`).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub's security-policy page for the repository says "No security policy detected" and offers no private vulnerability reporting; the README names no channel for security reports (searched for: security@, vulnerability, responsible disclosure, report security).

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release 3.40.0 is dated 2026-11-12; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-13; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-14.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: Scraping, crawling and browser interaction are available by default; the README documents a `CLOUD_SERVICE` mode with stricter defaults. Quoted: “`CLOUD_SERVICE=true` serves the tools over streamable HTTP on `PORT` (default `3000`, bound to `0.0.0.0`) with stricter defaults”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The API key is supplied through an environment variable, or OAuth on the hosted endpoint. Quoted: “env FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=fc-YOUR_API_KEY npx -y firecrawl-mcp”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The documented function is retrieving arbitrary web addresses through the Firecrawl API; the README also documents feedback tools that are registered unless opted out. Quoted: “Scrape any URL into clean Markdown”; “**Opt out:** set `FIRECRAWL_NO_SEARCH_FEEDBACK=1`”.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`pnpm-lock.yaml`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.3.1. Lower-bound version 2.3.1 of @modelcontextprotocol/server (npm) was published on 2026-10-05, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
